finding: tests/test_signal_search.py:261 AC4's detector-metadata search coverage is incomplete.
rationale: AC4's locked plan explicitly promises title, description, assumptions, and false-positive metadata as separately observable searchable fields, but the sole detector-metadata test queries only title, so removing any of the other field names from the production projection remains reachable and green; no upstream guard or fail-safe supplies coverage for those omissions.

evidence.command: grep task.json for gate hash; read task.md and notes.md:19-23,39-44
evidence.output: task.json binds the clean green gate to checkpoint 8d6157f854c2ed7d0b9527ec57d922e745f37a53. task.md AC4 requires lexical search of detector metadata, and the locked plan makes that concrete as detector title/description/assumptions/false-positive metadata with matched_on reporting.

The canonical fixture gives detector metadata distinct searchable values for title, description, assumptions, and false_positives, but the parameter matrix has only one detector-metadata case: ('allocation', ['signal-alpha', 'signal-beta'], 'detector.title'). No query or matched_on assertion exercises detector.description, detector.assumptions, or detector.false_positives.

_validated_metadata separately accepts title/description as strings and assumptions/false_positives as string lists; _search_fields enumerates ('title', 'description', 'assumptions', 'false_positives') and joins list values before emitting detector.<field>. Deleting description, assumptions, or false_positives from that tuple would remove a promised consumer-visible search path without affecting the existing title case.
